training_universe: ALL candidate_train windows excluding every observed group touching candidate_test or legacy_test
input_eligibility: canonical83_v1, at least64/80 valid ego frames and at least2 valid adjacent acceleration cells; finite valid input/targets
mask_contract: canonical83_v1 channel_valid/ego_valid/presence; same identity derivative masks
diagnostic_rule: first256 eligible train identities by sha256(RBR_V2_PROD_V1:DIAGNOSTIC:<scenario>:<actor>:<start>:<length>); IN_SAMPLE_NUMERICAL_ONLY
checkpoint: epoch30 only; never select diagnostic minimum
shared_gradient_audit: first actual batch each epoch; other batches one backward, same total objective; pretrain equivalence proof mandatory
reconstruction: same15pct two-frame span mask_plan, vectorized first-visit algorithm; RNG hash manifest+identity, seed3407+epoch
initialization: fresh random initialization, never load Smoke parameters
data_shard: one source TFRecord per committed shard; immutable SHA-certified arrays; incomplete attempts preserved
mmap_policy: read-only mappings; grouped batch gathers; no full tensor concatenation; RSS guard8GiB
resume: same run identity, complete model+optimizer+RNG+epoch order+next offset+partial loss; completed logs reconcile to checkpoint; no numerical failure restart
